newsitem.title: DUBAI: Emirates airline gets $126 mln loan for Boeing 777.
newsitem.headline: Emirates airline gets $126 mln loan for Boeing 777.

text.p: Dubai government-owned Emirates airline said on Monday it had signed a $126 million financing agreement with an international consortium of banks for the third of seven Boeing 777 twinjets on order.
An Emirates statement said the financing was led by Emirates Bank International and Deutsche Morgan Grenfell.
It said the financing "will utilise a Japanese leveraged lease...supported by the British Export Credit Guarantee Department (ECGD)."

"The 12-year debt component of the transaction will be provided at a fixed interest rate of 6.68 percent by Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, Emirates Bank International, Barclays Bank Plc, Banque Paribas and the Industrial Bank of Japan Ltd while the Japanese equity has been arranged by Sanwa Bank," the statement said.
It said the aircraft is scheduled for delivery on October 16 and will arrive in Dubai on October 17.
Emirates has received two Boeing 777s of the seven on firm order. It has options on seven more 777s.
